propositions: Links present in authoritative snapshot entries with issuelinks key must be recorded as peer-confirmed with direction=snapshot, source=snapshot, link_id from entry id, and current pass_id.
Snapshot entries missing the issuelinks key (unobserved state) must be skipped entirely and produce no confirmation record, even if the link is locally managed.
Authoritative empty issuelinks lists ([]) produce no confirmation record and do not remove or invalidate existing confirmations.
Links whose source or target jira_key cannot be bound to local ids must be skipped without raising an exception.
Relation mapping via link_direction.resolve_inbound_link must map inward link directions to local vocabulary (e.g. inbound Blocks becomes depends_on).
Exceptions during snapshot confirmation must be logged and caught, allowing the reconcile pass to complete and persist normally.
